[P2] Establish regression coverage for destructive retry recovery

Neither new test file exercises `deleteRolledBackStack` or its retry callback. Removing the callback would preserve the reported rollback bug without failing a test; inverting this guard could delete a healthy stack after a deployment error without failing one either. CONTRIBUTING rules 4 and 5 require coverage and a reproducing test. Following rule 9, return to the design phase with a testable recovery flow covering delete → wait → retry and no deletion for absent stacks or other statuses.
